$comment: Figma motion -> WBP implementation map. Source timings extracted from melodia-design-system/wix/*.html (transitions/keyframes) + DESIGN-SYSTEM.md S11 intro sting. Textures live at Content/Melodia/UI/Textures/Figma/ (gitignored, on-disk 2026-08-04). WBP hosts stay under their single-writer owners: battle/rhythm via UMelodiaUIBridgeSubsystem, Quill via Quillscript interpreter, ExploreUI via its own path.

entries.notes: Pop uses gallery/project card-motion curve; halo reuses line-glow 4s loop. Duration 0.45s = 0.4s curve rounded to UE frame grid.
entries.tier_gate: Chrome shows pop without halo loop; Off shows static grade text

entries.notes: Burst sweep uses image-zoom 0.6s timing; per-particle twinkle randomized 2-5s like hero-cosmic --duration stars.
entries.tier_gate: Density Full 1.0 / Soft 0.5 / Chrome 0.25 / Off skip (scaffold density_mapping)

entries.notes: Ambient layer drift; reverse variant for second layer. Pause when motion tier Off or reduced-motion.
Slow orbit carries rotation; individual sparkles twinkle on top at 4.8s.
entries.tier_gate: Chrome slows orbit to 0.25x; Off freezes at rest pose
entries.ue_easing: Linear-ish (use EaseInOut only if UE orbit wobble acceptable)

entries.notes: Cut-in sweep enters on fade-up timing, then pulses like section-header star until consumed. Pairs with Game_ULTMeter fill.
entries.tier_gate: Off shows static cut-in, no pulse

entries.notes: Same card-motion curve as GradePop; triggers on toughness-break event, not on timer.
entries.tier_gate: All tiers show reveal; Chrome/Off skip glow bloom

entries.notes: Width transition per streak increment; bar chart timing verbatim.
Opacity/scale breathe borrowed from star-pulse timing; keep amplitude small on ivory surfaces (motif budget).
entries.wbp_target: Menu + Quill panel idle (WBP_MenuButton background, Quill dialog frame)

entries.notes: Rotation/sheen on select/confirm; image-zoom timing verbatim.
Sheen sweep across button/parchment on hover-enter; matches MenuButton scaffold SparkleOnHover.
entries.tier_gate: Off disables sweep (hover state still applies statically)

entries.notes: Row-by-row entrance; reuse hero-cosmic fade-up cascade verbatim for SoftMG baroque rows.
entries.tier_gate: Chrome/Off show all rows instantly, no cascade

entries.notes: Iridescent shimmer loop on portrait surfaces; keep subtle per glow-rationing rule (S4.4).

intro_sting.notes: DESIGN-SYSTEM.md S11: 1s astral-star draw-on + rule wipe + gold glow bloom for reels/turntables. Reserved for non-gameplay surfaces (menus, lookbook); never on HUD gameplay feedback.
